title: Everyday Phrases — The Dentist Visit
title_quote: I need to see a dentist today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🦷 實用看牙醫必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — The Dentist Visit
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用看牙醫情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從牙痛打電話預約、搶最早的空檔、首次就診填表與保險卡複印、塞車遲到改期，到候診叫號、躺上牙醫椅、戴護目鏡、檢查牙齒與照X光、查出幾個蛀洞，接著洗牙、上含氟藥膠、拋光、補牙打麻藥、張口痠了舉手暫停、漱口與吸水器，最後術後別咬到嘴唇、兩小時再吃東西、止痛藥與冰敷、約下次複查、櫃台付款排期與牙線推薦，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical The Dentist Visit phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole visit: calling with a toothache, grabbing the earliest slot, first-visit forms and a copy of your insurance card, running late and rescheduling; the waiting room, the dental chair, protective glasses, the exam and the X-ray, and how many cavities were found; then the cleaning, fluoride gel, polishing, the numbing shot for a filling, raising your hand for a break, rinsing and the suction tube; finally aftercare, waiting two hours before eating, painkillers and ice packs, booking the next checkup, paying at the counter and the floss recommendation. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to see a dentist today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tu si ə ˈdɛntɪst təˈdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What seems to be the trouble?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back tooth hurts so badly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long has it been hurting?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started two nights ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you chew?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, cold water is the worst.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any swelling in your face?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No swelling, only the pain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me check the schedule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I come in this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This morning is fully booked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see people on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until two in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is your earliest opening?
dialogue.zh: 最早的空檔是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today at two fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That time works fine for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will hold that for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðæt fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 好的，我先替您保留這個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I will be there on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, aɪ wɪl bi ðɛr ɑn taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you a new patient here?
dialogue.zh: 你是第一次來我們這兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I came here last year.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I have your full name?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is Daniel Brooks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March third, nineteen ninety.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick one, your middle initial?
dialogue.zh: 再問一下，中間名的縮寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the letter J.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I found your chart.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，看到你的病歷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I see the same doctor?
dialogue.zh: 我看的是同一位醫師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doctor Lee will see you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, she was very kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How can we reach you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is five five five, oh one two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz faɪv faɪv faɪv, oʊ wʌn tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that your mobile now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is the best number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you still have insurance?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same plan as last year.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring the card with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a copy too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A copy saves ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could email it instead.
dialogue.zh: 我也可以用郵件傳過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please send it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which address should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the one on our website.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will be there in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl bi ðɛr ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You also have forms to sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those forms online?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fill them out before arriving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will print them at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or write them at our desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How early should I arrive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes early is best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should I plan for?
dialogue.zh: 我大約要預留多少時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add twenty minutes for paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my medical history?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: List every medicine you take.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pill for blood pressure.
dialogue.zh: 我在吃一顆降血壓的藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that dose on the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else I should mention?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any allergy to medicine?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, you are booked for two fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ju ər bʊkt fər tu fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 好的，兩點十五分替您約好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text you a reminder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is Daniel Brooks again.
dialogue.zh: 我是丹尼爾·布魯克斯，又打來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi Daniel, is everything okay?
dialogue.zh: 丹尼爾你好，一切都還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am stuck in heavy traffic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About how late will you be?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe twenty minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the open slots.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下還有哪些空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry for the trouble.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still keep my slot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doctor Lee can wait a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or should I come much later?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是晚一點再過來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come as soon as you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my exam be shorter now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we keep your full time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss it completely?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we book another day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for changing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee this time, it is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fi ðɪs taɪm, ɪt ɪz faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pain is stronger than before.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell the nurse that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just turned onto your street.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are waiting for you here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the best place to park?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə bɛst pleɪs tu pɑrk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lot behind the building.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the entrance on the side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use the side door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the elevator up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, sign in right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I hand my card over now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hænd maɪ kɑrd ˈoʊvər naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要把卡遞給你們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we scan it right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My insurance card is right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will copy the front and back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkɑpi ðə frʌnt ənd bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我幫你正反面都印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want my old records?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you changed clinics.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, same clinic as always.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我一直在同一家診所。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, you are all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I miss my slot after all?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ mɪs maɪ slɑt ˈæftər ɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Doctor Lee waited for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I sit and wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chairs are on your left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I fill out anything else?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your forms are complete.
dialogue.zh: 沒了，你的表格都齊全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer is the wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe fifteen more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I read these magazines?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take any one you like.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my name shown on a screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ neɪm ʃoʊn ɑn ə skrin?/
dialogue.zh: 我的名字會顯示在螢幕上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also call it out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is me, I am coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daniel, please come with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I carry my bag in?
dialogue.zh: 我的包包也要帶進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it in this drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wait here by myself?
dialogue.zh: 我要自己先在這裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dentist will be right in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair looks enormous.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and hold the arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it go all the way back?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ ɔl ðə weɪ bæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will lower it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that feels a bit strange.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe normally, you are fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this cloth for?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your clothes clean.
dialogue.zh: 它讓你的衣服保持乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, water sprays a lot here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tie it snug for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl taɪ ɪt snʌɡ fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These glasses are for me?
dialogue.zh: 這副眼鏡是給我戴的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they protect your eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wear these the whole time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɛr ðiz ðə hoʊl taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them on till I say stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ɑn tɪl aɪ seɪ stɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They make me look silly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone looks silly here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡每個人都一個樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps quite a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now open wide for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, or wider still?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little wider, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My jaw is getting tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will finish the check soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, it gets tiring.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here comes a tiny mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels cold on my tongue.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows me your back teeth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you tap my teeth now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell me each sharp pain.
dialogue.zh: 對，哪一顆刺痛就告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one hurts, right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the pain sharp or dull?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharp, like a quick shock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any pain when I press here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only a little pressure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your gums look red.
dialogue.zh: 好，你的牙齦看起來發紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They bleed when I brush.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you clench at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife says I grind loudly.
dialogue.zh: 我太太說我磨牙很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains your worn edges.
dialogue.zh: 那就說明牙緣為何磨損。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that going to cost much?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will talk money after.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You found two small cavities?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two, and nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a lot of cavities?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but we must fix them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which teeth have the holes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lower left back teeth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me where they are?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ʃoʊ mi wɛr ðeɪ ɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 你能指給我看是哪幾顆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See this dark spot right here?
dialogue.zh: 看這裡，這個暗點看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dark spot is the hole?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Decay starts under the surface.
dialogue.zh: 蛀蝕是從表面底下開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep has it gone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is close to the nerve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a root canal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, a filling may work.
dialogue.zh: 還不用，補牙可能就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you need X-rays today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, films show what I cannot see.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, fɪlmz ʃoʊ wət aɪ ˈkænɑt si./
dialogue.zh: 要，片子能看到我看不到的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I go for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors down, the small room.
dialogue.zh: 進去第二間，那間小房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to remove anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take off your glasses now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This heavy apron is for me?
dialogue.zh: 這件厚重的圍裙是給我穿的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It blocks the radiation.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the radiation strong here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dose is very small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready to try.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bite gently on that tab.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Should I hold still?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and do not swallow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That clicking noise was loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need two more angles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many more pictures total?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, then we are done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the films ready to view?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They appear on this screen now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see anything worse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your wisdom tooth grows sideways.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that need surgery soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, we watch it first.
dialogue.zh: 現在不用，先觀察一陣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any tooth I should worry about?
dialogue.zh: 有哪顆牙要特別擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back left one, nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 左後面那一顆，其他都好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we start fixing it?
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候開始處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We begin with a cleaning now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, let us start then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First comes the scraping step.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that hurt at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may feel some scratching.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scratching sounds a little scary.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only removes the hard tartar.
dialogue.zh: 那只是清掉變硬的牙結石。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had no idea it was there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæd noʊ aɪˈdiə ɪt wʌz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道有那個東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tip hums and sprays water.
dialogue.zh: 這支尖端會嗡嗡響，還會噴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the water sprayer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the straw sucks it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðə strɔ sʌks ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 對，那根吸管會把它吸走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hate that sucking feeling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe through your mouth, it helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to rinse, take the cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup feels nice and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swish, then spit in the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tongue keeps getting in the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʌŋ kips ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɪn ðə weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest it on the roof, high up.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ɪt ɑn ðə ruf, haɪ ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tip reaches your back teeth now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɪp ˈritʃɪz jʊr bæk tiθ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 尖端現在清到你後面的牙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I gag when you touch there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wiggle your toes instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is left to clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more side, then polishing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you clean under the gums?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that keeps them healthy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My teeth feel smoother already.
dialogue.zh: 我的牙已經感覺比較滑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next comes a fluoride gel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that gel do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes your enamel stronger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it taste sweet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the mint flavor today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mint happens to be my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 薄荷剛好是我最喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not eat for thirty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 三十分鐘內不要吃東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing to eat at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water is fine right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes, I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the polishing tool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels like a tiny brush.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lifts the surface stains.
dialogue.zh: 它能把表面的色斑去掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My smile looks brighter now.
dialogue.zh: 我的笑容看起來亮多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Floss goes between every tooth.
dialogue.zh: 牙線要進到每顆牙之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I skip that part at home.
dialogue.zh: 我在家都會跳過那一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it every night this month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will set a phone reminder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, your gums will thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn, jʊr ɡʌmz wɪl θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 很好，你的牙齦會感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will do it every night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleaning is done, now the filling.
dialogue.zh: 洗牙結束，現在要補牙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we numb it first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I rub a gel on your gum.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ rʌb ə dʒɛl ɑn jʊr ɡʌm./
dialogue.zh: 要，我先在你牙齦塗藥膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the gel sting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It numbs you before the needle.
dialogue.zh: 它會在下針之前先麻掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the shot hurt much?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick pinch, nothing more.
dialogue.zh: 就像輕輕捏一下，沒別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can handle a pinch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out slowly for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, in and out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, keep doing exactly that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was quicker than I expected.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes five minutes to work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I know it worked?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Touch your lip, is it thick?
dialogue.zh: 摸摸你的嘴唇，變厚了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels like nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the numbness is working.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lip looks bigger too.
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇看起來也變大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wears off by evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drive home after this?
dialogue.zh: 結束後我能自己開車回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, driving is fine today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I have no other ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open wide, we start the filling.
dialogue.zh: 請張大嘴，我們開始補牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long must I keep open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a long time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise your hand if it aches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you will stop right away?
dialogue.zh: 你們就會馬上停下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stop at once, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am raising my hand now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ æm ˈreɪzɪŋ maɪ hænd naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stopped, rest your jaw here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to go again now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we continue from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel only pushing, no pain.
dialogue.zh: 我只覺得有人在推，不痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pressure is normal, pain is not.
dialogue.zh: 有壓力是正常，痛才不正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear a loud drilling sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ear plugs may help with that.
dialogue.zh: 戴耳塞可以減弱那個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a pair for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə pɛr fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有一副可以給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, put these in now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much quieter, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me if you need a rinse.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ɪf ju nid ə rɪns./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup is empty already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will refill it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tube keeps sucking my cheek.
dialogue.zh: 那根管子一直吸到我的腮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will move it aside now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please also wipe my face.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a warm napkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we test the bite?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bite on this colored paper.
dialogue.zh: 咬一下這張有色的試咬紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels a little high.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will shave it down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it feels flat and smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the filling is done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything finished now?
dialogue.zh: 今天的治療全部結束了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are done for today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lip is still so numb.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will stay numb for about two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl steɪ nʌm fər əˈbaʊt tu ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 麻感還會持續大約兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I must be careful there.
dialogue.zh: 所以我對那邊要特別小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, chew only on the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tʃu ˈoʊnli ɑn ði ˈʌðər saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could bite my cheek badly.
dialogue.zh: 說不定會狠狠咬到腮幫子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens, so take it slow.
dialogue.zh: 常常發生，所以動作慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When may I eat again?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候可以再吃東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait two hours first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not even a small snack?
dialogue.zh: 連一點小點心都不行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water is fine right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have warm soup later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, heat hurts more.
dialogue.zh: 今天不行，熱的會更不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So cold food is my choice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, try yogurt or soft rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will avoid nuts and candy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also no chewing gum.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the filling falls out?
dialogue.zh: 要是補的料掉了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, and call us.
dialogue.zh: 把它收好，然後打電話給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same day, or can it wait?
dialogue.zh: 要當天處理，還是可以等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please call the same day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is some pain normal after this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little soreness is normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does soreness last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe two or three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take pain medicine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, either kind is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ibuprofen or acetaminophen?
dialogue.zh: 布洛芬還是對乙醯氨基酚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both work well for this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pills, and when?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pill every six hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take it with food?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take it after eating.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never two pills at once?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that will not help more.
dialogue.zh: 不行，多吃也不會更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use ice on my face?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ juz aɪs ɑn maɪ feɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ice helps the swelling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long on my cheek?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes, then a rest.
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，然後休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wrap it in cloth?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never put ice on bare skin.
dialogue.zh: 千萬別把冰直接貼皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use a small towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repeat that every hour today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about tonight while sleeping?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep with your head raised.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One extra pillow, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that eases the throbbing.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那樣比較不會跳痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mouth tastes odd now.
dialogue.zh: 我嘴裡現在味道怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse gently with salt water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I do that tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times each day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times, after meals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I brush that area?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but be very gentle there.
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過那邊要刷得非常輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not want to upset it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt wɑnt tu ʌpˈsɛt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The filling is hard already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it cannot move now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still avoid hard food today.
dialogue.zh: 不過今天還是別咬硬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drink coffee tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let it cool a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my tooth feel sensitive?
dialogue.zh: 我那顆牙會對冷熱敏感嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a few days, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the pain gets worse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us, do not wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even in the middle of the night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl əv ðə naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is an after-hours line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will save that in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪv ðæt ɪn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我會把那個號碼存進手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You also need to come back.
dialogue.zh: 你另外還得再回來一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next visit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six months for a checkup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that all I need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the other tooth next week.
dialogue.zh: 不是，下週還要補另一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time as today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesday morning, if that works.
dialogue.zh: 星期三早上，看你可不可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mornings are hard for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then three fifteen that day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three fifteen works great for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk will text you.
dialogue.zh: 櫃台會傳簡訊跟你確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay before I go?
dialogue.zh: 我走之前要把錢付了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just pay at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I owe for today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insurance covers most of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So only a small part?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just thirty dollars today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chip or tap, which one works?
dialogue.zh: 要插晶片還是感應付款？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap your card here.
dialogue.zh: 把卡在這裡輕點一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, did it go through?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here is your receipt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell floss here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the mint kind near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə mɪnt kaɪnd nɪr ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，門口那款薄荷的就不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The waxed kind or the plain one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wækst kaɪnd ər ðə pleɪn wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the waxed, it slides easily.
dialogue.zh: 試試上蠟的，很好滑進牙縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell those small brushes?
dialogue.zh: 你們賣那種小牙間刷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they clean the back teeth.
dialogue.zh: 有，它們能清後面的牙縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My gums still bleed a little.
dialogue.zh: 我的牙齦還是會有一點流血。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a soft brush, call if it bleeds.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ə sɔft brʌʃ, kɔl ɪf ɪt blidz./
dialogue.zh: 改用軟毛牙刷，還流血就打電話來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I feel much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you on Wednesday then.
